description: Sequential switch passing one of four inputs to a single output, stepped by a clock or crossfaded by CV

inputs.text: One of the four signals the switch chooses between
A rising edge advances the switch to the next input, wrapping round after the fourth
Patching anything here turns off stepping and crossfades instead, 0V putting the output on the first input and 5V on the fourth
A rising edge sets the switch back to the first input

outputs.text: The selected input, or the crossfade across all four while the CV jack is patched

notes: With the CV jack patched, the clock and reset no longer move the switch; the crossfade takes over for as long as a cable is in CV.

inputs.4: high above 1.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5:
0 to 5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.6: high above 1.5V · stepped · one channel only
